The parametrized terminal-drain test covers both the empty-optional case and the no-capability case.

CLOSURE | resolved | ⚪ `skip_empty_drain_capabilities` stamps `completed_at` from `datetime.now(UTC)` instead of the injected clock | The supervisor now passes `completed_at=_timestamp(self._clock.now())`. The wall-clock fallback is still reachable for callers that omit the argument (see the LOW finding below).

LOW | src/ovcaq/state/commands.py:632 | `skip_empty_drain_capabilities` keeps `completed_at: str | None = None` with a `datetime.now(UTC)` fallback. Update the one test call that omits it.
